# Planner Task Creator CLI MCP

> A command-line tool and MCP server for creating and managing Microsoft Planner tasks with AI assistant integration.

## Overview

Planner Task Creator CLI MCP provides:
- A Python CLI for managing Microsoft Planner tasks
- A TypeScript/Node.js MCP server for AI assistant integration
- Microsoft Graph API integration with OAuth2 device code flow
- Task creation, listing, updating, and comment management

## Key Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cocodedk/Planner-Task-Creator-CLI-MCP)
- [Documentation](https://github.com/cocodedk/Planner-Task-Creator-CLI-MCP/tree/main/0-docs)

## Tech Stack

- Runtime: Node.js 20 (TypeScript), Python 3.12
- API: Microsoft Graph API
- Auth: MSAL (OAuth2 device code flow)
- Testing: pytest (Python)
- CLI: Typer + Rich
